sourcesRejected.github.com/Techial/DBD-Database: NOT a JSON dump - the repository contains only Node.js scraper source (db/, jobs/, routes/). No data files to fetch.
sourcesRejected.deadbydaylight.wiki.gg Cargo: No usable Cargo tables. Special:CargoTables lists only the internal _pageData, so the cargoquery path used on terraria.wiki.gg does not exist here.
sourcesRejected.dbd.tricky.lol/api/apidocs: Cloudflare-challenged (403). Only /api/<endpoint> is reachable; the endpoint list was mapped by probing.

licence.deadbydaylight.wiki.gg: Text content CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. Status-effect names and descriptions are derived from the Dead by Daylight Wiki (wiki.gg).
licence.dbd.tricky.lol: Community-run API over game data. Used with attribution; no licence is asserted over the underlying game strings.
licence.images: Game icons and portraits are (c) Behaviour Interactive Inc. Mirrored locally for offline use under the same community-wiki convention as the other routes in this app. Non-commercial, unofficial fan project.

attribution: Status effects and all icons: Dead by Daylight Wiki (deadbydaylight.wiki.gg), CC BY-NC-SA 3.0
Dead by Daylight is a trademark of Behaviour Interactive Inc. This is an unofficial fan project.

rarityScheme.note: rarity is normalised; rarityRaw keeps the source token. The source ships "visceral", which the game displays as Iridescent.

names: Raccoon City Police Station East Wing
Raccoon City Police Station West Wing

shrineCors.verdict: CORS BLOCKED - no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header. A browser on https://bluefiiish.github.io CANNOT fetch this endpoint directly; a live shrine widget needs a proxy or a scheduled re-pull of data/shrine-static.json.

notes: gameVersion is null on purpose: no source exposes the live game build number.
items[].charges is populated only where the item description states a charge count; otherwise null.
maps[].killers is derived from the shared chapter key, so base-game and survivor-only chapters yield an empty array.

Killer movementSpeed / terrorRadius are BASE values in m/s and metres (Unreal cm / 100). The Shape has no base terror radius (it is a function of Evil Within tier) and is emitted as null rather than a made-up number.
statuses.json holds two families, tagged by `system`: 22 true status effects and 9 proficiency indicators, which share one icon set on the wiki.
Add-on icons are tier 2: they are downloaded only if the sprite budget has room, otherwise iconRemote carries them.
